# Relay Publisher

> Relay Publisher is a local-first desktop social scheduler that publishes by driving real platform web interfaces through user-controlled Chrome profiles. It avoids platform APIs but introduces Terms-of-Service, account, and UI-drift risk.

Source: https://github.com/tanzir71/scheduler
Safe mock demo: /demo/

## Required caveats

- Web-UI automation violates most platforms' terms; challenges, temporary blocks, or account loss are possible.
- Circuit breakers, global concurrency one, human pacing, cooldowns, jitter, and daily caps reduce risk but cannot remove it.
- Platform selectors change; budget for roughly one adapter repair per month.
- Instagram and TikTok are fragile and may require manual fallback.
- Real-platform smoke tests require owner login/2FA and create public posts. They are never run by CI or claimed by the website.
- The public demo is browser-only canned data. It never contacts a platform or posts content.
- Relay never automates login or exports cookies. Drafts, media, browser profiles, logs, and proof stay local.
